name: KeyboardScroll
description: Easily navigate lists and pages using keyboard and mouse

page-right.name: Next Page
page-right.description: Key to go to the next page

page-left.name: Previous Page
page-left.description: Key to go to the previous page

page-mouse-scroll-toggle.name: Enabled
page-mouse-scroll-toggle.description: Enable/disable horizontal mouse scroll. Use Shift (by default) + MWheelUp/MWheelDown to scroll

page-mouse-scroll-key.name: Scroll Modifier
page-mouse-scroll-key.description: A key that, when pressed, allows you to scroll pages horizontally using MWheelUp/MWheelDown

scroll-sensitivity.name: Keyboard Scroll Sensitivity
scroll-sensitivity.description: Controls the scrolling speed of lists when using the keyboard
